related_repositories.math-modeling-to-sci-skill: The legacy source repository this project was migrated from. Recorded in docs/MIGRATION.md and docs/LEGACY_VERIFICATION.md as provenance, so it may legitimately appear in GitHub URLs. It is not this project.

note: Single source of truth for the repository slug used in internal URLs. The project's display name is Cool-Academic, but the GitHub repository is still named Ku-academic. Links must use the slug that exists today: GitHub redirects the old slug to the new one after a rename, but not the other way round, so the old slug keeps working both before and after. When the repository is renamed, change repo here and run python -m unittest tests.test_repository_identity -v, which lists every file still using the old slug.
